header.superHtml:
This candy-loving duo may embrace their sugar bugs, but they blast off yours when they start "shaking it" to toothy tunes. Research shows a 73% increase in brushing time using musical toothbrushes. Brushes have four songs, play music for two minutes (the dentist recommended time for brushing), and automatically shut off when the tune is done. Kids can also watch the Tooth Keri magically come to life using the included augmented reality (AR) sticker for tips on how to make their teeth sprite brite. (When you press the button the sonic and song turns on and automatically shuts off after two minutes)

  • plays music for two minutes
  • comes with 4 songs
  • augmented reality sticker: 'Tooth Keri' - your child's interactive guide to proper brushing and flossing, brought to life through engaging AR technology
  • recommended for ages: 2-12 years

reviews.title: Well, he definitely brushes his teeth.
reviews.body: Before a musical toothbrush, on a lucky day, my son brushed his teeth for 30 seconds. Now he at least has it in his mouth for the whole two minutes. And sometimes more, like maybe five. Now to get him to focus more on not just eating the toothpaste.
